tasks.subject: Task 3: Error normalization — Graph error codes + throttling 429 -> errorSignature
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement `GraphErrorNormalizer.Normalize(Exception)` mapping Graph ODataError/ApiException (and 429 throttling with Retry-After) into stable credential-free `errorSignature` strings the Core IErrorCatalog matches (CONTRACTS §3, §8), exposing parsed RetryAfter — never including tenant identifiers or secrets.

**Files:**
Create: `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph/GraphErrorNormalizer.cs`
Create: `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph/GraphNormalizedError.cs`
Create: `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph.Tests/GraphErrorNormalizerTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- 429 errorThrottledRequest -> 'graph:429:throttled', IsTransient=true, RetryAfter from Retry-After header.
- 404 ErrorItemNotFound -> 'graph:404:ErrorItemNotFound', non-transient.
- 403 ErrorAccessDenied, 401 InvalidAuthenticationToken map to their signatures.
- 503 serviceUnavailable -> transient with RetryAfter.
- Signature never contains tenant id/account/secret even when embedded in error message.
- Generic exception -> 'graph:unknown', non-transient.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~GraphErrorNormalizerTests` -> all pass.


tasks.subject: Task 12: Security Verification (USER-ORDERED GATE)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the Graph connector's security focus from the INDEX per-plan table: client secret/tokens never logged; OAuth scope least-privilege (Mail.ReadWrite only via .default); token cache never persisted to disk in plaintext; 429 handling does not leak tenant identifiers into user-facing errors.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
Create: `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph.Tests/GraphSecurityVerificationTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No secret in logs: with a captured in-memory ILogger over a TestConnection + Write attempt triggering 403/429, scanning every captured message and scope shows zero occurrences of the client secret and zero occurrences of the access-token value (scanned-entry count printed).
- Least-privilege scope: GraphClientFactory.GraphScopes and GraphConnectionConfig.GraphScopes both equal exactly ['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default']; static-source assertion (grep over connector .cs) shows 'Mail.Send' and broad '\"Mail.Read\"' do not appear as requested scopes (zero matches captured).
- Token cache not on disk: BuildCredentialOptions().TokenCachePersistenceOptions is null; static-source assertion confirms 'new TokenCachePersistenceOptions' never appears in connector sources (matched lines captured).
- 429 does not leak tenant: feeding an ODataError whose message embeds tenant GUID/account/secret into Normalize (429 + Retry-After) yields 'graph:429:throttled' containing none of them; WriteResult.ErrorCode from a throttled WriteMessageAsync (WireMock 429 with tenant id in body) contains none of them (produced signature + ErrorCode captured).
- TLS enforced + no arbitrary-host exfiltration: production client BaseUrl starts with https://graph.microsoft.com (asserted at runtime) and static-source scan shows no http:// and no foreign https host literal in connector .cs (only https://graph.microsoft.com permitted).
- Config redaction: GraphConnectionConfig.ToString() does not contain the client secret (ToString output captured).

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~GraphSecurityVerificationTests` -> all pass.

